old:
Using a modern minimalist design the Malaga vanity range represents a fantastic addition to any bathroom. It features finger pulls instead of handles .

  • Sizes: 600, 750, 900 and 1200mm wide, 630mm high, 455mm deep
  • Finger-pull doors and drawers, no handles
  • Supplied as cabinet; add a basin or top to suit
  • Finish: Antico Oak melamine
new:
The Malaga Antico Oak Wall Hung Vanity is a handle-free cabinet with finger-pull doors and drawers, in four widths from 600 to 1200mm. It is supplied as the cabinet only, so you choose the top and basin to suit, and the wall-hung design keeps the floor clear for easy mopping.

Use it for

  • Bathrooms and ensuites that want a clean, minimal vanity
  • Pairing with a stone top and above counter basin, or a ceramic top

Specifications

  • Widths: 600, 750, 900 and 1200mm (cabinet measures 590, 740, 890 and 1190mm wide)
  • Height: 630mm
  • Depth: 455mm
  • Doors and drawers with finger pulls, no handles
  • 600mm: two drawers; 1200mm: four drawers with room for two basins
  • Finish: Antico Oak melamine
  • Model: OJS106

Good to know

  • Supplied as cabinet; add a basin or top to suit
  • Fix to studs or a noggin; a wall hung vanity carries the top, basin and water on the wall
  • Matching kickboard, cubby cabinet and single door cabinet are listed separately
notes: Actual cabinet widths and drawer layout from supplier diagrams (600 and 1200 drawn).

title: Capsule LED Oval Backlit Mirror 450 x 900mm
old:
●Change between 3 tones
● Built-in demister
● Illuminating touch sensors for light and demister

● Wall mounting screws and anchor plugs included
● Supplied in extra strong packaging for added protection
● 220-240V AC 50/60Hz
● Please note: Mirror must be installed by a licensed electrician in accordance with local regulations.
Dimensions: 450 x 900mm
new:
The Capsule LED Oval Backlit Mirror is a 450 x 900mm pill-shaped mirror with LED light behind the glass, so it throws a soft halo onto the wall instead of glaring at you. Touch the sensor to change between three light tones, and the built-in demister keeps the glass clear after a shower.

Use it for

  • Vanities in ensuites and main bathrooms
  • Powder rooms where a tall narrow mirror suits the wall

Features

  • Backlit LED with three light tones, changed at the touch sensor
  • Built-in demister with its own touch sensor
  • Can be hung portrait or landscape

Specifications

  • Size: 450 x 900mm
  • Power: 220-240V AC 50/60Hz
  • Model: MIRBLEDOVAL

What's in the box

  • Mirror, wall mounting screws and anchor plugs, in extra strong packaging

Good to know

  • Must be installed by a licensed electrician in accordance with local regulations
  • Allow for a power point or hard-wired connection behind the mirror
notes: Features confirmed on distributor product page; orientation listed both ways there.
